3-MODUL O'Z-O'ZINI BAHOLASh, 2-BET (91-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda yashil 'Module Self-Assessment 3 (Units 9 - 12)'.

CHAP USTUN:
7) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.' 1 If everyone put their rubbish in the bin, we ...... (have) cleaner streets. 2 If there ...... (be) more lifeguards, there would be fewer swimming accidents. 3 If you ...... (ride) your bicycle to work, you would get more exercise. 4 If I had the money, I ...... (visit) Paris. 5 If I ...... (go) on a safari, I would hope to see a lot of wild animals. 6 If the city improved public transport, fewer people ...... (use) their cars. (6 marks)
8) 'Fill in who, which or where.' 1 This is the place ...... I first met Sally. 2 An alarm clock is something ...... wakes you up. 3 This is the place ...... we keep the tools. 4 The police still haven't found the man ...... robbed the bank. 5 Sheila is the girl ...... found my dog. 6 A fridge is something ...... keeps food fresh. (6 marks)
• To'q sariq 'Communication'.
9) 'Complete the dialogues with phrases from the list.' Qiya: 'Can I help, What shall we, I'd love to, If I were you'. YIRTIQ QOG'OZLAR: 1 A: ...... do this Saturday? B: How about going fishing? A: Oh no! Not again. 2 A: I can't run fast. B: ......, I'd stop smoking. 3 A: Museum of Natural History Information Desk. ...... you? B: Yes, please. Could you tell me when the museum is open? A: Certainly. From 9:00 to 6:00 daily. 4 A: Let's go skiing, shall we? B: ......, but I can't. I've promised to go out with Pam. (8 marks)

O'NG USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Reading'.
10) 'Read the news report and put the verbs into the correct tense, then match the paragraphs to the headings.' OCh SARIQ QUTI, sarlavha '9-YEAR-OLD INJURED IN HOUSE FIRE'. 1-xatboshi: 'Nine-year-old James Wilson was injured in a house fire in Manchester last Monday.' 2: 'The fire 1) ...... (start) when James was at home with his brother, Tom, aged sixteen. James had found a box of matches and 2) ...... (try) to light some candles when he set fire to the living-room curtains. The fire 3) ...... (spread) quickly through the house. Tom Wilson 4) ...... (hear) his brother's screams and rushed bravely through the flames to save him. They 5) ...... (escape) through a downstairs window. A neighbour called the fire brigade while an ambulance 6) ...... (take) the two boys to hospital. They suffered mild burns.' 3: 'Since the accident, the fire brigade 7) ...... (start) a campaign warning parents to keep matches out of reach of children.' Pastda qiya: 'detailed description of the event ......, summary of the event ......, action taken ......' (10 marks)
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing'.
11) 'Write a news report about Thomas Brown using the notes below (50 - 100 words). Use the text in Ex. 10 as a model.' (20 marks) SURAT: maysada o'tirgan qizil futbolkali yigit. QAYDLAR 'Narrow Escape': - 24 year-old British student Thomas Brown - nearly drowned while swimming yesterday - on holiday - four friends - go swimming after eating - got cramp, began to drown - friends help him reach the beach - tourist call ambulance - take to hospital - doctors' press release - do not swim after eating. 'TOTAL: 100 marks'.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '91'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form. (6 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying. (6 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
2-TUR ShART GAPLARI (11-unit):
  if + past simple, would + fe'l

JAVOBLAR:
  1 would have  2 were  3 rode
  4 would visit  5 went
  6 would use


⚠ 'IF THERE WERE':

  'there is/are' → 'there were'
  (2-tur).


⚠ RIDE:

  ride - RODE - ridden.

4 If I had the money, I ___ (visit) Paris.

exercises.instructionUz: who, which yoki where ni qo'ying. (6 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
NISBIY OLMOShLAR (12-unit):
  who = odam; which = narsa;
  where = joy.

JAVOBLAR:
  1 where (place)
  2 which (alarm clock)
  3 where (place)
  4 who (the man)
  5 who (the girl)
  6 which (fridge)


⚠ 'AN ALARM CLOCK':

  = budilnik.


⚠ 'TO ROB':

  = o'g'irlamoq (bank).
  ⚠ 'robber' = o'g'ri.

Yangiliklar xabarini o'qing va fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying, keyin xatboshilarni sarlavhalarga moslang. (10 ball)

9 YoShLI BOLA UY YoNG'INIDA JAROHATLANDI
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) To'qqiz yoshli James Wilson
o'tgan dushanba Manchesterda uy
yong'inida jarohatlandi.

2) Yong'in James uyda o'n olti yoshli
akasi Tom bilan bo'lganida boshlandi.
James gugurt qutisini topgan va sham
yoqmoqchi bo'lganida mehmonxona
pardalariga o't qo'yib yubordi.
Yong'in uy bo'ylab tez tarqaldi. Tom
Wilson ukasining qichqirig'ini
eshitdi va uni qutqarish uchun
alanga orasidan jasorat bilan yugurdi.
Ular pastki qavat derazasidan
qochib chiqishdi. Qo'shni o't
o'chiruvchilarni chaqirdi, tez yordam
esa ikki bolani kasalxonaga olib
ketdi. Ular yengil kuyish oldilar.

3) Baxtsiz hodisadan beri o't
o'chirish xizmati ota-onalarni
gugurtni bolalar qo'li yetmaydigan
joyda saqlashga ogohlantiruvchi
kampaniya boshladi.


JAVOBLAR (fe'llar):
  1 started  2 was trying
  3 spread  4 heard  5 escaped
  6 took  7 has started

  ⚠ 2 - 'was trying ... WHEN he set
  fire' - davomli ish, uzilgan.
  ⚠ 7 - 'SINCE the accident' →
  present perfect.


SARLAVHALAR:
  detailed description of the
    event → 2
  summary of the event → 1
  action taken → 3


⚠ 'TO INJURE':

  = jarohatlamoq.


⚠ 'TO SET FIRE TO':

  = o't qo'ymoq.


⚠ 'TO SPREAD':

  spread - spread. = tarqalmoq.


⚠ 'TO RUSH':

  = shoshilmoq, yugurmoq.


⚠ 'BRAVELY':

  = jasorat bilan.


⚠ 'THE FIRE BRIGADE':

  = o't o'chirish xizmati.


⚠ 'TO SUFFER':

  = azob chekmoq, (jarohat) olmoq.


⚠ 'A CAMPAIGN':

  = kampaniya. /kæmˈpeɪn/ - 'g'
  o'qilmaydi.


⚠ 'OUT OF REACH':

  = qo'l yetmaydigan joyda.

exercises.instructionEn: Write a news report about Thomas Brown using the notes below (50 - 100 words). Use the text in Ex. 10 as a model. Narrow Escape: 24 year-old British student Thomas Brown - nearly drowned while swimming yesterday - on holiday - four friends - go swimming after eating - got cramp, began to drown - friends help him reach the beach - tourist call ambulance - take to hospital - doctors' press release - do not swim after eating (20 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi qaydlardan foydalanib Thomas Brown haqida yangiliklar xabari yozing (50-100 so'z). 10-mashqdagi matndan namuna sifatida foydalaning. Qil ustida qutulish: 24 yoshli britaniyalik talaba Thomas Brown - kecha suzayotganda deyarli cho'kib ketdi - ta'tilda - to'rt do'st - ovqatdan keyin suzishga borishdi - tirishish, cho'ka boshladi - do'stlari plyajga yetishga yordam berdi - sayyoh tez yordam chaqirdi - kasalxonaga - shifokorlar matbuot bayonoti - ovqatdan keyin suzmang (20 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
YANGILIKLAR XABARI TUZILIShI
(10-mashq kabi):

  1 - QISQAChA: kim, nima, qachon
  2 - BATAFSIL: nima bo'ldi
  3 - KO'RILGAN ChORA

  ⚠ O'TGAN ZAMON (past simple,
  past continuous), oxirida present
  perfect ('has issued').
  ⚠ 50-100 so'z.


⚠ 'A NARROW ESCAPE':

  = qil ustida qutulish.


⚠ 'TO GET CRAMP':

  = tirishmoq (mushak).


⚠ 'A PRESS RELEASE':

  = matbuot bayonoti.
  ⚠ 'to issue a press release' =
  bayonot bermoq.

structure.modelEn: Twenty-four-year-old British student Thomas Brown nearly drowned while swimming yesterday.
structure.modelUz: Yigirma to'rt yoshli britaniyalik talaba Thomas Brown kecha suzayotganda deyarli cho'kib ketdi.

structure.modelEn: Thomas was on holiday with four friends. They went swimming after eating lunch. Thomas got cramp and began to drown. His friends helped him reach the beach, and a tourist called an ambulance, which took him to hospital.
structure.modelUz: Thomas to'rt do'sti bilan ta'tilda edi. Ular tushlikdan keyin suzishga borishdi. Thomas tirishib qoldi va cho'ka boshladi. Do'stlari unga plyajga yetishga yordam berishdi, bir sayyoh esa tez yordam chaqirdi, u uni kasalxonaga olib ketdi.

structure.modelEn: Since the accident, doctors have issued a press release warning people not to swim after eating.
structure.modelUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan beri shifokorlar odamlarni ovqatdan keyin suzmaslikka ogohlantiruvchi matbuot bayonotini berishdi.

modelAnswers:
NARROW ESCAPE

Twenty-four-year-old British student Thomas Brown nearly drowned while swimming yesterday.

Thomas was on holiday with four friends. They went swimming after eating lunch. Thomas got cramp and began to drown. His friends helped him reach the beach, and a tourist called an ambulance, which took him to hospital.

Since the accident, doctors have issued a press release warning people not to swim after eating.
modelAnswersUz:
QIL USTIDA QUTULISh

Yigirma to'rt yoshli britaniyalik talaba Thomas Brown kecha suzayotganda deyarli cho'kib ketdi.

Thomas to'rt do'sti bilan ta'tilda edi. Ular tushlikdan keyin suzishga borishdi. Thomas tirishib qoldi va cho'ka boshladi. Do'stlari unga plyajga yetishga yordam berishdi, bir sayyoh esa tez yordam chaqirdi, u uni kasalxonaga olib ketdi.

Baxtsiz hodisadan beri shifokorlar odamlarni ovqatdan keyin suzmaslikka ogohlantiruvchi matbuot bayonotini berishdi.

patterns.exampleEn: James was trying to light candles when he set fire to the curtains.

patterns.formula: Since the accident, X has + V3.
patterns.exampleEn: Since the accident, the fire brigade has started a campaign.
patterns.exampleUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan beri o't o'chirish xizmati kampaniya boshladi.

patterns.exampleEn: This is the place where I first met Sally.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu men Sallyni birinchi marta uchratgan joy.
